name: Mamiya Kotomi
source:
A fellow student of protagonist's school.

As a member of basketball club, she trains enthusiastically everyday. She spends most morning and after-school times on club activity. Always takes a shower after that. 

"My body feels weird recently... I wonder is it because of the stress from training?"
